run_count_toxicity_sources: run the toxicity source analysis script to count toxic words across languages and save CSV results
run_skip_compilation: run the toxicity source analysis with skip compilation flag to read pre-compiled raw results
count_toxic_words_per_language: count toxic word matches per translated sentence and categorize aligned source words by descriptor noun or template
analyze_aligned_word_categories: analyze the distribution of aligned word categories across languages and save fraction breakdowns to CSV
generate_pivoted_word_counts: generate a pivoted table of toxic word counts by aligned word category word and language
